findings.reason: A click on a shadow item in the header does not always open that shadow. The click navigates to `/releases?tab=shadow&ref=<id>`, but the screen only reacts when the search params change: ReleasesPage compares `seen.tab`/`seen.ref` with the props, and ReleasesShadowsTab compares `seenRef` at ReleasesShadowsTab.tsx:48. Suppose the URL is already `?tab=shadow&ref=a` (the user arrived through the header). The user then clicks the Releases or Changes tab, which is screen state and leaves the URL alone, or picks shadow `b` in the picker. Clicking shadow `a` in the header now navigates to the same location. The props do not change, so the screen stays on the List/Compare tab, or keeps showing `b`. The goal says a click on a shadow item leads to the Shadows tab for that shadow. That holds on the first click but not on a repeated one. Possible fixes: carry a per-click token (for example navigation state or a nonce) that ReleasesPage and ReleasesShadowsTab treat as a new request. Or have onOpenShadow (GitStatusBadge.tsx:111) reach the screen directly when the target matches the current location. Then add a test that clicks the same header shadow again after switching tab or after a different pick.
